title: Street-side name sign over the entry
where: north face, z=9..10, x=23..24, y=4..5 (black panel right of the porch)
instruction: The panel already holds two glowing wall signs ('12' / 'DUNE WALK'). Replace them with one clearer pair: x=23 y=4 text lines ['', 'No 12', '', ''], x=24 y=4 ['', 'SEAGLASS', 'HOUSE', ''], white glowing text, birch wall signs facing north (B.sign with glow:true).

title: Real surfboards, finish the rack
where: east face of the lower volume (x=26, y=4 and y=6), z=11, 12, 20, 21, undercroft
instruction: Make each board read as a board: keep the stacked pair of wall banners, but use patterns [['stripe_center', stripe], ['border', rim]] -> z=11 white + orange stripe, z=12 light_blue + white stripe, z=20 red + white stripe, z=21 white + cyan stripe, then add two birch fence posts with a birch slab shelf at x=26,y=3,z=10 and z=22 as the rack ends.

title: Dune grass and a driftwood log along the deck
where: sand strip x=4..37, z=31..33, south of the deck
instruction: Place 8-10 small tufts: grass_block at y=1 with short_grass / dead_bush at y=2 on the sand, in clumps of 2-3, none within 1 block of the steps (x=16..19 and x=30..32) or the jetty; add 2 stripped_birch_log (axis x) lying on the sand at x=24..26, z=32.

title: Outdoor shower by the pool
where: deck, x=14, z=26..27, y=3..6, east end of the pool coping
instruction: Build a stripped_birch_log post y=3..6 at (14,3,27), an iron_bars rail on top at y=7 for the shower head, a gray_concrete base slab at (14,2,27), and a trapdoor (birch, open, facing west) as the tap at y=4 one block off the post.

title: Roof-terrace shade sail
where: roof terrace of the lower volume, x=6..11, z=14..18, y=8..11
instruction: Four stripped_birch_log posts at the corners of x=6/11, z=14/18, y=8..11, joined by birch slabs (top) at y=11 and a lattice of birch trapdoors (open) across the top; keep the lounger pair under it.

title: Roof detail: rooftop solar array
instruction: Swap the roof's top slabs in a 2-row x 5-column block grid for daylight_detector blocks sitting flush in the roof (replace the slab at y=12 with daylight_detector), leaving a 1-slab border, to read as solar panels. Do not touch the fascia or soffit.

title: Glass balustrade posts and corner caps
instruction: The tinted-pane balustrade is thin from the street: add a smooth_quartz_slab cap (top) at y=3 on the deck-edge row every 6th block (x=4,10,16... skipping stair gaps x=16..19, 30..32) as posts, using fixture(g,{at, mount:'top'}) lanterns on the two corner pillars (4,3,30) and (37,3,30).

title: Soften the north wall of the upper volume
where: north face, upper volume x=13..34, y=8..11 (z=10)
instruction: Add slim smooth_quartz_slab sills under the ribbon window (y=8, x=15..32, one out, top slab) and four recessed shadow-gaps on the piers (x=20,21,27,28): remove the white concrete at y=11 on each pier by exclusion and back it with gray_concrete.

title: Pool lounge: floating daybed and towels
where: deck, x=5..13, z=23 (between pool and house)
instruction: Place a 3-long daybed at x=7..9 z=23 y=3 from quartz slabs (bottom) with cyan_carpet cushions on top at y=4 and an orange_carpet towel on x=10, plus two potted plants (flower_pot with cactus) at x=5 and x=13.

title: Even out the sand: wet-sand and ripples at the shoreline
instruction: Replace a 1-block irregular strip of sand directly beside the water with smooth_sandstone (already partly present) and alternate with coarse_dirt every 5th cell to read as wet sand; do not touch the jetty at x=17..18.
